import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:attest_flutter/attest_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

Widget app(Widget home) => MaterialApp(home: Scaffold(body: home));

final clean = Column(
  children: [
    const Text('Sign in', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 24)),
    const TextField(decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: 'Email')),
    ElevatedButton(onPressed: () {}, child: const Text('Continue')),
  ],
);

final broken = Column(
  children: [
    IconButton(onPressed: () {}, icon: const Icon(Icons.settings)),
    Image.memory(
      base64Decode(
        'iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==',
      ),
      width: 48,
      height: 48,
    ),
    const Text(
      'Low contrast',
      style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFCCCCCC), fontSize: 14),
    ),
    const TextField(),
  ],
);

Future<void> audit(WidgetTester tester, String screen, Widget body) async {
  await tester.pumpWidget(app(body));
  await tester.pumpAndSettle();
  final report = await tester.auditAccessibility(screenName: screen);
  File('build/a11y/$screen.json')
    ..parent.createSync(recursive: true)
    ..writeAsStringSync(jsonEncode(report.toJson()));
}

void main() {
  testWidgets('clean screen', (tester) => audit(tester, 'SignIn', clean));
  testWidgets('broken screen', (tester) => audit(tester, 'Settings', broken));
}
